_doc: Shrink-only disclosed list of gates in the four populations beyond the validate scopes (gz obpi precomplete checks, gz obpi complete refusals, gz closeout gates, and gz check steps that run no gz validate) that no registered enforcement claim names (GHI #1155 acceptance (a)). Seeded 2026-10-02 at the population measured on main by gate_population.population_members(). An entry records a DISCLOSED absence of a control, never a justified one. NEVER add an entry to silence a new gate; register a claim instead (ADR-0.0.73 Boundary Invariant #8). An entry MUST be surrendered the moment a claim names its member (gz validate --gate-enrollment fails on a stale one). Ratcheted via data/waiver_ratchet_registry.json.
